topography.project_purpose: Lending. Structurally: 107 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 26 ERC20 tokens, 1 ERC721 NFT; role-gated via AccessControl; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 10 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (versionedinitializable, lendingpoolstorage, debttokenbase). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
